summary: Re-tested the public AccountEase preview. Mocked frontend login, shop/customer search and navigation, ledger rendering, inclusive date filtering, add-record validation and manual balance insertion, print preview, WhatsApp action, logout, and mobile overflow all passed. The live backend is still the starter FastAPI service, so requested Spring/PostgreSQL/JWT API integration is unavailable.

critical.issue: Live endpoint returns 404 for both demo and invalid credentials; supervised port 8001 runs backend/server.py starter app rather than the Spring API.
Live organization and customer routes return 404, preventing API-backed navigation and persistence.
Live transaction route, including date-filter parameters, returns 404.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend App.js contains only local seeded state and hardcoded demo credential handling; no fetch/axios calls use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. These flows are MOCKED and do not exercise live persistence or owner authorization.

action_items: Deploy/configure the Spring Boot API under supervisor on the public backend route, or implement the same routes in the running FastAPI service.
Wire frontend authentication and all organization/customer/transaction CRUD flows to REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL after the API is available.
Verify PostgreSQL environment variables are present at runtime and run Maven compilation in an environment with mvn installed.
Return complete created organization/customer/transaction objects, including IDs, from POST endpoints for frontend state synchronization.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py remains the MongoDB status-check starter and is the actual supervised runtime; the Java PostgreSQL implementation is not deployed.
Frontend hardcodes rajesh/demo123 and local initialShops/initialCustomers, so logout is only React state reset and records are not persisted.

ApiController createOrganization calls organizations twice and selects the last sorted row rather than returning the inserted row reliably; createCustomer returns no generated ID and transaction responses echo request data without the persisted ID.
JwtService implements a custom two-part HMAC token rather than a standard JWT and will fail startup/runtime if JWT_SECRET is absent; ensure fail-fast configuration and deployment wiring.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data created; only existing local frontend seed data was exercised.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview URL is https://customer-accounts-13.preview.emergentagent.com. Frontend UI checks passed with exact record-button selectors. backend/tests/backend_test.py has five API regression tests and all currently fail with 404. /app/memory/test_credentials.md contains no credentials; request-provided rajesh/demo123 was used only for the mocked UI login.
rca of the issue: Supervisor status shows uvicorn server:app on port 8001. backend/server.py defines only /api/, /api/status, and POST /api/status, while the requested routes exist only under backend/src/main/java and are not compiled or launched. Maven is unavailable in the container, so Spring compilation could not be verified. Frontend App.js has no network client usage and uses seeded React state, making preview success independent of backend availability.
